description: Source code for FastAPI route handlers managing weather event planning, scoring, and recommendations. Includes endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, scoring, and generating recommendations for events, integrating weather data and notification stubs.

methods.name: EventResponse create_event(payload: EventRequest, repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo))
methods.description: Handles creation of a new event and stores it in the in-memory repository.

methods.name: List[EventResponse] list_events( userId: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter events by associated user ID"), repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo), )
methods.description: Returns a list of stored events, optionally filtered by user ID.

methods.name: EventResponse get_event( event_id: str = Path(..., description="Event identifier"), repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific event by its ID, raising 404 if not found.

methods.name: RecommendationResponse get_recommendations( event_id: str = Path(..., description="Event identifier"), repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo), )
methods.description: Provides placeholder recommendations for an event with mock scores and sends notification.

methods.name: ScoreResponse score_event_date(payload: ScoreRequest)
methods.description: Asynchronously scores weather suitability for a specified date and location, returning sorted options.

methods.name: RecommendationResponse post_recommendations(payload: RecommendationRequest)
methods.description: Generates weather-aware recommendations for ad-hoc events without persisting.
